description: Start a new life in the enchanting town of Portia! Restore your Pa's neglected workshop to its former glory by fulfilling commissions, growing crops, raising animals, and befriending the quirky inhabitants of this charming post-apocalyptic land! Armed with your Pa's old handbook and workbench, you must gather, mine and craft your way to being crowned the number one workshop in Portia. Help the locals rebuild the town and uncover the secrets locked deep away beneath it. Be prepared though…it won't be easy! The town of Portia is full of friendly new faces for you to meet. topReviews.review:
Look, My Time at Portia is a perfectly nice, pretty game, but it suffers from a severe case of "Older Sibling Syndrome." It walked so its sequel could sprint.

If you are a die-hard cozy game fanatic who needs to inject every single crafting simulator directly into your veins, buy it. You’ll have a lovely time. But if you’re a regular human playing this today, the entire experience is going to feel distinctly... off.

Playing Portia now feels like trying to build Ikea furniture while wearing oven mitts. Controls are pure, unfiltered jank, and the resource grind is less "relaxing weekend hobby"…
topReviews.zh_review: 《波西亚时光》是一款还不错、挺漂亮的游戏，但它患有严重的'姐姐综合症'——它走路了，好让续作能冲刺。如果你是硬核休闲游戏狂热爱好者，需要把每个制造模拟器直接注入血管，买吧，你会玩得开心。但如果你是个正常人今天才玩，整个体验会感觉明显……不对劲。现在玩波西亚感觉就像戴烤箱手套组装宜家家具。操作是纯粹的、未经过滤的生硬，资源肝度不是'放松周末爱好'而是'第二份全职工作'。
